recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學影像：放大後的 G 顯帶中期分裂相，約 46 條染色體分散良好、可見明暗帶紋，重疊少，是品質適合進行核型分析的中期細胞。
features: Magnified GTG-banded metaphase spread with chromosomes well separated and minimal overlap
Chromosomes elongated (prometaphase-to-metaphase length) with clear alternating light and dark bands
Centromeric constrictions discernible on many chromosomes, aiding identification
Chromosome identity and any abnormality cannot be determined until arranged into a karyogram
describe_en: This is a cytogenetic image, not a morphologic smear, showing an enlarged view of a GTG-banded metaphase spread from a cultured bone marrow aspirate. The chromosomes are well dispersed with minimal overlap and show clear banding and centromeric constrictions, indicating a metaphase of good quality for analysis. Such spreads are counted and then arranged into a karyogram by length, centromere position and banding pattern. No abnormality can be interpreted from this unarranged spread, and findings require correlation with blood and marrow morphology.
